It lists the wiki assertions that are not yet proved but whose recorded prerequisites (the statement and proof dependencies extracted from Lean, plus the authored `proof_uses` of the wiki records) are all proved. `proved-modulo` (named literature inputs), `statement-only` and `unformalised` count as unproved. Ordering: within each article, by the number of blocked assertions that would become ready once the entry is proved (*unblocks*), then by the number of unproved assertions depending on it transitively (*dependents*), then by tag; articles follow the rank of their first entry.

To regenerate (from the repository root, after `lake build`):

```
lake env lean --run scripts/ExtractManifest.lean > .lake/manifest-raw.json
python3 scripts/build_manifest.py .lake/manifest-raw.json --output .lake/manifest.json
python3 scripts/frontier.py .lake/manifest.json --proof-uses wiki/records \

```
